ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) zone at the peduncle junction. Left lobe is characterized by high-intensity (white) background with dense, overlapping low-intensity linear clusters. Right lobe is primarily high-intensity white with sparse, discrete low-intensity linear markings and a prominent dark patch on the inner proximal margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations. The left lobe trailing edge displays extreme raggedness with deep, non-uniform valleys. The right lobe shows more consistent, moderate-amplitude serrations along its boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature along the outer lateral margins, with the right lobe following a more continuous geometric arc than the fragmented left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across both lobes, intersecting the primary pigmentation patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular truncation and raggedness of the trailing edge on the left lobe, indicating significant past physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct region of yellowish-tan pixel intensity located on the lower distal section of the left lobe's ventral surface.
